annotations.title: Estimate AI replies under an X post

description: Estimate what share of the replies under an X (Twitter) post look AI-generated or bot-driven. Pass the reply texts with any author details (handle, bio, followers, following, joined date, default avatar) and timestamps you have; the post text and time sharpen the estimate. Returns the percentage, a band and a 0-100 score with signals for every reply. An estimate from patterns, not proof about any account. Docs: https://isgenai.com/x-ai-replies

replies.description: The replies to score, one object per reply.
